giggle.wav: derived from 02-laughter.wav
laugh.wav: derived from 03-laughter.wav
Only the nonverbal laughter recordings are included.
Processing: trim leading/trailing silence with 80/120ms padding, convert to mono
PCM16, normalize peak to -3dBFS, apply 10ms fades. Original pitch retained.
Reproduction: python tools/art/import_voice.py tools/.cache/audio/bright.zip
Runtime: dedicated voice channel at -8dB; no overlapping laughter.
